UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private Angel OS user account profile and OOBE completion metadata, strictly scoped to the authenticated owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: User chosen display name shown on the Angel OS Start Menu and lock screen.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL or emoji token.

themePreset.description: Selected Angel OS visual theme preset.

oobeCompleted.description: Whether the user completed the Windows-style first-run setup wizard.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserOsSave.title: UserOsSave
UserOsSave.description: Strictly private per-user Angel OS workspace snapshot including registry preferences, installed package IDs, user files, bookmarks, stickies, trophies, and taskbar order.

registry.description: Native map of Angel OS display, shell, audio, browser, and hardware preferences.

installedPkgIds.description: List of installed Angel OS package IDs from the 500+ app store.

vfsUserFiles.description: Bounded list of user-created virtual files (documents/notes).

taskbarOrder.description: Ordered list of pinned taskbar app IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the save document was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the save document was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile metadata owned strictly by userId.

/users/{userId}/saves/{saveId}.description: Private Angel OS desktop state snapshot owned strictly by userId.
